rows.scope: Classify whole numbers, integers, and rational numbers with a visual display of number-set relationships; Venn diagrams are an example.
Identify a number, its opposite, and its absolute value.
Locate, compare, and order integers and rational numbers on a number line.
Order rational numbers arising in mathematical and real-world contexts.
Recognize fraction a/b as the same numerical value as a divided by b, requiring a nonzero divisor b.
